Financial impact of the Nordnet private-banking JV - explicitly promised for this report; sign unknown (JV formal scale-up 2027, subject to approvals, so a Q3 gain is unlikely; set-up costs or a deconsolidation note more likely). Small either way.

Efficiency-programme progress and possibly restructuring one-offs in Q3 ('additional measures expected to be executed over the coming quarters'); slight negative on reported EPS, positive on cost outlook.
No guidance expected; ABGSC gives none. Pipeline commentary from interim CEO only.
